entities.name: Grinth
entities.description: Grinth the Mindbreaker, human red telepath soldier in a two-faced helmet, sent by Vronos to capture Garruk and killed by him.

entities.name: Vronos
entities.description: Summoned planeswalker hunters to capture Garruk.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Planeswalker hunted by Vronos's hunters who killed Grinth.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel to whom Garruk was to be brought for a cure.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where Vronos summoned the hunters.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane where the group found Garruk.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Grinth confronted Garruk.

events.summary: Vronos summons Grinth and other planeswalkers on Innistrad to capture Garruk and bring him to Avacyn for a cure.
events.quote: Grith was summoned by Vronos in Innistrad

events.summary: Grinth confronts Garruk near a high spire in Esper and at first overwhelms him with mental attacks.
events.quote: Although Grinth initially reduced Garruk with his mental attacks

events.summary: Grinth dies at Garruk's hands, the third hunter to do so.
events.quote: he ended up lying dead on the ground

relations.note: He was one of the hunters sent by Vronos.
relations.quote: one of the Planeswalker hunters sent by Vronos to capture Garruk
the third to die at his hands
